items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Bill Matthews? Well, I heard Bill a couple of times play drum on the street.

ctx.x: Now, if you could ask him more about the other drummers, I don't know who you've talked about, but what about the Matthew boys, how many of those did you hear?
Bill Matthews? Well, I heard Bill a couple of times play drum on the street.
He played last year, I think he played Isidore Barbera. Paul's father, you know when he died, he played this funeral on drums, didn't he?
